get.description: Returns a list of top-level files and folders. Use the folderId query parameter to retrieve nested resources.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Set the internal folderId to receive items within a folder.

parameters.name: isFolder
parameters.description: Specifies whether or not the output of the received payload contains both files and folders, or only folders (if set to true)

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Define the sort order of the received payload.

parameters.name: sortField
parameters.description: Specify the field used for sorting.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Define how many items will be received in the payload per request.(default 20 items)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Allows to filter by the search phrase over name property.

parameters.name: createdAtFrom
parameters.description: Filter by createdAt date FROM the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

parameters.name: createdAtUntil
parameters.description: Filter by createdAt date UNTIL the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

parameters.name: updatedAtFrom
parameters.description: Filter by updatedAt date FROM the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

parameters.name: updatedAtUntil
parameters.description: Filter by updatedAt date UNTIL the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

200.description:
Returns list of top level files (and folders).
    In order to get nested resources, please use folderId param.

post.description: Upload one or more files using multipart/form-data. Optionally specify a target folder via the metadata payload.

get.description: Resolve a file or folder by its slash-delimited path (e.g. "Engineering/Specs/vacuum.pdf") and return its metadata.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Slash-delimited path including the filename (e.g., "Engineering/Specs/vacuum.pdf"). Path must be URL-encoded.

get.description: Retrieve the metadata of a single file or folder by its unique identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Internal file id to receive metadata of a file.

patch.description: Update the metadata of a file or folder by its unique identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Internal file id to change the metadata for a file or folder.

delete.description: Delete a file or folder by its unique identifier. This is a cascading operation — all nested child items will also be permanently deleted.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Internal id to delete a file or a folder. Caution: Deletion is a cascading operation so all child items will also be deleted.

get.description: Download the binary content of a file by its unique id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Internal file id to receive just the binary of a file.

post.description: Create a new folder. Optionally specify a parent folder to create a nested folder.

patch.description: Replace the binary content of an existing file by its unique id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Internal file id to replace the binary of a file.

file.description: Replace the current binary of a file with a new binary.

209.description: The file was removed from AI Copilot

fileType.description: It is a mime type of a file or 'folder' in case of folder.

aiKnowledgeBaseStatus.description: Indicates whether or not the file is added to the knowledge base.

isPublic.description: If this parameter is set to true, the uploaded files will be visible in the portal.

parentId.description: Set the internal parentId to nest a file inside a folder.

assetNumber.description: Specify an assetNumber and assetType to assign a file to a specific asset. You can use assetNumbers instead to assign multiple assets

assetTypes.description: Specify a list of assetTypes to assign a file to them.

assetNumbers.description: Specify a list of assetNumbers to assign a file to them.

isAddedToKnowledgeBase.description: Specify if the file should be added to the knowledge base for the AI Copilot.
